get.summary:
Calculates crosswind and headwind components for all runways at an airport using the latest METAR wind data.
Returns components for each runway end and recommends the best runway (lowest crosswind with a headwind).
Requires the airport to have a current METAR with wind data and at least one runway with heading information.

parameters.name: icaoCodeOrIdent
parameters.description: ICAO code or airport identifier

200.description: Returns crosswind data for all runways

400.description: If METAR is missing required wind data

404.description: If the airport or METAR is not found

post.summary:
Calculates crosswind and headwind components using manually provided wind and runway heading values.
Useful when you want to calculate components for specific conditions rather than using live METAR data.

requestBody.description: Wind direction (degrees), wind speed (knots), optional gust speed (knots), and runway heading (magnetic degrees)

400.description: If the request parameters are invalid

get.summary:
Calculates density altitude for an airport using the latest METAR temperature and altimeter data.
Optionally override the temperature or altimeter setting (e.g., for "what if" scenarios).
Returns density altitude, pressure altitude, ISA temperature, and temperature deviation.
get.description:
Density altitude is calculated using the ISA (International Standard Atmosphere) model approximation:
DA = PA + 120 × (OAT − ISA_temp). Real atmospheric density varies with humidity, local pressure
patterns, and non-standard lapse rates that this model does not account for.

parameters.name: icaoCodeOrIdent
parameters.description: ICAO code or FAA identifier (e.g., KDFW, DFW)

parameters.name: TemperatureCelsiusOverride
parameters.description: Override temperature in Celsius (uses METAR if not provided)

parameters.name: AltimeterInHgOverride
parameters.description: Override altimeter setting in inHg (uses METAR if not provided)

400.description: If METAR is missing required data and no override provided

404.description: If the airport or METAR is not found

post.summary:
Calculates density altitude using manually provided field elevation, altimeter setting, and temperature.
Useful for any location or for calculating with non-current weather conditions.
post.description:
Density altitude is calculated using the ISA (International Standard Atmosphere) model approximation:
DA = PA + 120 × (OAT − ISA_temp). Real atmospheric density varies with humidity, local pressure
patterns, and non-standard lapse rates that this model does not account for.

requestBody.description: Field elevation (feet MSL), altimeter setting (inches of mercury), and temperature (degrees Celsius)

400.description: If the request parameters are invalid

post.summary:
Calculates true heading and ground speed using the wind triangle.
Given true course, true airspeed, wind direction, and wind speed, returns the wind correction angle,
true heading, ground speed, and headwind/crosswind components.

requestBody.description: True course (degrees), TAS (knots), wind direction (degrees), wind speed (knots)

400.description: If the request parameters are invalid

post.summary:
Calculates true airspeed (TAS) from calibrated airspeed, pressure altitude, and outside air temperature.
Uses the full compressible isentropic flow conversion (CAS → impact pressure → Mach → TAS),
accurate from sea level through FL410+ including above the tropopause (36,089 ft).
Also returns density altitude and Mach number at the given conditions.
Reference: ICAO Doc 7488 (Standard Atmosphere), isentropic flow relations.
post.description:
This calculation assumes the ISA tropopause at 36,089 ft. The real tropopause varies from
~26,000 ft near the poles to ~55,000 ft near the equator. Pressure ratio and temperature
model transitions at this boundary affect TAS accuracy at high altitudes in non-mid-latitude regions.

400.description: If the request parameters are invalid

post.summary:
Estimates cloud base height AGL from surface temperature and dewpoint.
Uses the standard spread × 400 formula (equivalent to spread / 2.5 × 1000).
post.description:
This estimation uses the average dry adiabatic lapse rate (~3°C/1000 ft) and dewpoint lapse
rate (~0.5°C/1000 ft) to approximate the lifting condensation level. Actual cloud bases vary
with humidity profiles, inversions, and local convective conditions.

400.description: If dewpoint exceeds temperature

post.summary:
Calculates pressure altitude from field elevation and altimeter setting.
PA = field elevation + (29.92 − altimeter) × 1000.
post.description:
This uses the standard altimetry relationship from the ICAO Standard Atmosphere. The 1 inHg ≈ 1000 ft
approximation is most accurate near sea level and diverges slightly at higher altitudes and extreme
altimeter settings.

requestBody.description: Field elevation (feet MSL) and altimeter setting (inHg)

400.description: If the altimeter setting is out of range

post.summary:
Calculates a complete VFR navigation log for a cross-country flight. Provide an ordered list of
waypoints and aircraft performance data (airspeeds, climb/descent rates, fuel burn rates).
The response includes per-leg calculations (true/magnetic course, heading, ground speed, distance,
time, fuel burn, wind data) and identifiers for airspaces and obstacles along the route.
Use the returned AirspaceGlobalIds with GET /api/v1/airspaces/by-global-ids,
SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds with GET /api/v1/airspaces/special-use/by-global-ids,
and ObstacleOasNumbers with POST /api/v1/obstacles/by-oas-numbers to get full details.

requestBody.description: Navigation log request including ordered waypoints, aircraft performance data, cruising altitude, and departure time

400.description: If the request data is invalid (e.g., fewer than 2 waypoints)

503.description: If an external service (magnetic variation or winds aloft) is unavailable

post.summary:
Calculates the great-circle bearing and distance between two geographic points.
Returns true course, magnetic course (adjusted for local magnetic variation), and
distance in nautical miles. Useful for quick point-to-point calculations without
a full navigation log.

requestBody.description: Start and end point coordinates (latitude/longitude in decimal degrees)

200.description: Returns the bearing and distance calculation

400.description: If the coordinates are invalid

503.description: If the magnetic variation service is unavailable

Returns wind direction, speed, and temperature at standard altitude levels (3000, 6000, 9000, 12000,

that the navlog calculator uses internally to compute wind-corrected headings and ground speeds.

parameters.name: forecast
parameters.description: Forecast period in hours: 6, 12, or 24

400.description: If the forecast period is not 6, 12, or 24

503.description: If the winds aloft data source is unavailable

post.summary: Gets NOTAMs for a flight route (airports and/or waypoints)
post.description:
The route can be specified using either:
- AirportIdentifiers: Simple list of airport ICAO/FAA codes (e.g., ["KDFW", "KAUS"])
- RoutePoints: Ordered list of mixed airports and waypoints with coordinates
            
If both are provided, RoutePoints takes precedence.
            
Example RoutePoints request:
```json
{
  "routePoints": [
    { "airportIdentifier": "KDFW" },
    { "name": "Lake Travis", "latitude": 30.4082, "longitude": -97.8538 },
    { "latitude": 30.1, "longitude": -97.6, "radiusNm": 15 },
    { "airportIdentifier": "KAUS" }
  ],
  "corridorRadiusNm": 25
}
```

requestBody.description: Route query request with airport identifiers and/or route points with coordinates

400.description: If the request is invalid

get.summary:
Gets all current PIREPs. Returns all active pilot reports with reported conditions
including turbulence (type, intensity, altitude), icing (type, intensity, altitude),
and sky conditions. Each report includes the geographic coordinates and altitude where
the observation was made.

Gets the current TAF for a specific airport, including all forecast periods with expected
weather conditions (wind, visibility, sky cover, precipitation, turbulence, and icing).

parameters.name: icaoCodeOrIdent
parameters.description: ICAO code or FAA identifier (e.g., KDFW, DFW)

200.description: Returns the TAF with all forecast periods

404.description: If no TAF is found for the airport

PaginatedResponseOfAirportDto.description:
Cursor-based paginated response wrapper. To retrieve subsequent pages, pass the
pagination.nextCursor value as the cursor query parameter in your next request.
Continue until pagination.hasMore is false.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including the cursor to fetch the next page.

AirportDto.description:
Airport data from the FAA National Airspace System Resources (NASR) database.
Use the airport's IcaoId or ArptId to query related endpoints such as runways
(GET /api/v1/airports/{icaoCodeOrIdent}/runways), communication frequencies
(GET /api/v1/communication-frequencies/{servicedFacility}), METARs
(GET /api/v1/metars/{icaoCodeOrIdent}), TAFs (GET /api/v1/tafs/{icaoCodeOrIdent}),
airport diagrams (GET /api/v1/airport-diagrams/{icaoCodeOrIdent}), and
chart supplements (GET /api/v1/chart-supplements/{icaoCodeOrIdent}).

siteTypeCode.description: Site type code (e.g., A for airport, H for heliport).

city.description: City the airport is associated with.

magVarn.description: Magnetic variation in degrees. Combine with MagHemis to determine east/west deviation (e.g., 5E means add 5 degrees to true heading for magnetic heading).

magHemis.description: Magnetic variation hemisphere: E (east/add to true heading) or W (west/subtract from true heading).

arptStatus.description: Airport operational status: O (operational), CI (closed indefinitely), or CP (closed permanently).

fuelTypes.description: Available fuel types (e.g., "100LL", "JET-A", "MOGAS"). Comma-separated if multiple types available.

lastInspection.description: Date of the last FAA inspection.

lastInfoResponse.description: Date of the last information response.

PaginationMetadata.description:
Metadata for cursor-based pagination. Use nextCursor as the cursor query parameter
to fetch the next page of results. When hasMore is false, there are no more pages.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor value to pass as the cursor query parameter to fetch the next page. Null when there are no more results.

hasMore.description: True if more results are available beyond this page; false if this is the last page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned per page (1-500, default 100).

ApiErrorResponse.description: Standardized error response format for API errors.

message.description: Human-readable error message suitable for display.

details.description: Additional error details (only included in development environment).

validationErrors.description: Field-level validation errors (only for validation failures).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the error occurred.

traceId.description: Correlation ID for tracing the request.

path.description: Request path that generated the error.

RunwayDto.description: Runway data including dimensions, surface, and lighting information.

edgeLightIntensity.description: Edge light intensity (e.g., high, medium, low).

weightBearingSingleWheel.description: Single wheel weight bearing capacity in pounds.

weightBearingDualWheel.description: Dual wheel weight bearing capacity in pounds.

weightBearingDualTandem.description: Dual tandem weight bearing capacity in pounds.

weightBearingDoubleDualTandem.description: Double dual tandem weight bearing capacity in pounds.

runwayEnds.description: Runway end details for each direction.

RunwayEndDto.description: Runway end data including approach, markings, lighting, and obstacle information.

rightHandTrafficPattern.description: Whether right-hand traffic pattern is in effect.

latitude.description: Latitude of the runway end in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the runway end in decimal degrees.

elevation.description: Elevation of the runway end in feet MSL.

thresholdCrossingHeight.description: Threshold crossing height in feet AGL.

visualGlidePathAngle.description: Visual glide path angle in degrees.

displacedThresholdLatitude.description: Displaced threshold latitude in decimal degrees.

displacedThresholdLongitude.description: Displaced threshold longitude in decimal degrees.

displacedThresholdElevation.description: Displaced threshold elevation in feet MSL.

touchdownZoneElevation.description: Touchdown zone elevation in feet MSL.

visualGlideSlopeIndicator.description: Type of visual glide slope indicator (e.g., VASI, PAPI).

runwayVisibilityValueEquipment.description: Whether runway visibility value equipment is installed.

hasRunwayEndLights.description: Whether runway end identifier lights are installed.

hasTouchdownZoneLights.description: Whether touchdown zone lights are installed.

controllingObjectMarking.description: Marking type of the controlling obstacle.

controllingObjectClearanceSlope.description: Clearance slope of the controlling obstacle.

controllingObjectHeightAboveRunway.description: Height of the controlling obstacle above the runway in feet.

controllingObjectDistanceFromRunway.description: Distance of the controlling obstacle from the runway end in feet.

controllingObjectCenterlineOffset.description: Centerline offset of the controlling obstacle.

AirportDiagramsResponseDto.description:
Airport information with all available airport diagrams. Diagrams are FAA-published PDF charts
showing taxiways, runways, and other ground features. The PDF URLs are time-limited pre-signed URLs.

icaoIdent.description: ICAO identifier (e.g., KDFW). Use this to cross-reference with other endpoints such as METARs and TAFs.

airportIdent.description: FAA airport identifier (e.g., DFW). Use this to cross-reference with the Airports endpoint.

diagrams.description: List of available airport diagram PDFs with time-limited download URLs.

AirportDiagramDto.description: An airport diagram (e.g., Airport Diagram, Hot Spot, taxi chart) with a time-limited pre-signed URL for PDF download.

chartName.description: Name of the chart/diagram (e.g., "AIRPORT DIAGRAM", "HOT SPOT").

pdfUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the diagram PDF. This URL expires after a limited time period; request a new URL if it has expired.

AirsigmetDto.description: AIRMET or SIGMET advisory data including hazard information and affected area.

validTimeFrom.description: Start of the valid period in ISO 8601 format.

validTimeTo.description: End of the valid period in ISO 8601 format.

areas.description: Geographic areas affected by the advisory.

AirsigmetAltitude.description: Altitude range for an AIRMET or SIGMET advisory.

minFtMsl.description: Minimum altitude in feet MSL for the advisory area.

maxFtMsl.description: Maximum altitude in feet MSL for the advisory area.

AirsigmetHazardDto.description: Hazard type and severity information for an AIRMET or SIGMET advisory.

type.description: The weather hazard type: CONVECTIVE (thunderstorms/convection), ICE (icing), TURB (turbulence), IFR (instrument flight rules conditions), or MTN_OBSCN (mountain obscuration).

severity.description: Hazard severity. AIRMETs use LGT (light) or MOD (moderate). SIGMETs use MOD-SEV (moderate to severe) or SEV (severe). Convective SIGMETs do not have a severity value.

AirsigmetArea.description: Geographic area affected by an AIRMET or SIGMET, defined as a polygon of lat/lon points.

numPoints.description: Number of points defining the polygon boundary.

points.description: Ordered list of lat/lon points forming the polygon boundary of the affected area.

AirsigmetPoint.description: A geographic coordinate point forming part of an AIRMET/SIGMET area boundary polygon.

AirspaceDto.description:
Controlled airspace data (Class B, C, D, E) sourced from FAA ArcGIS.
Use the GlobalId to cross-reference with navigation log results — the navlog response's
AirspaceGlobalIds field contains GlobalIds from this endpoint for airspaces along a planned route.

globalId.description: ArcGIS global unique identifier. This is the key used to look up airspaces returned by the navigation log endpoint's AirspaceGlobalIds field.

upperUom.description: Upper altitude unit of measure (e.g., FT, FL).

upperCode.description: Upper altitude reference code (e.g., MSL, AGL).

lowerUom.description: Lower altitude unit of measure (e.g., FT, FL).

lowerCode.description: Lower altitude reference code (e.g., MSL, AGL).

class.description: Airspace class (e.g., B, C, D, E).

GeoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry representing an airspace boundary.

coordinates.description: Coordinate array defining the geometry boundary.

PaginatedResponseOfSpecialUseAirspaceDto.description:

Continue until pagination.hasMore is false.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata including the cursor to fetch the next page.

SpecialUseAirspaceDto.description:
Special use airspace data (restricted, prohibited, warning, MOA, alert) sourced from FAA ArcGIS.
Use the GlobalId to cross-reference with navigation log results — the navlog response's
SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds field contains GlobalIds from this endpoint for special use airspaces along a planned route.

globalId.description: ArcGIS global unique identifier. This is the key used to look up special use airspaces returned by the navigation log endpoint's SpecialUseAirspaceGlobalIds field.

typeCode.description: Type code (e.g., R for restricted, P for prohibited).

timesOfUse.description: Times of use for the airspace.

ChartSupplementsResponseDto.description:
Airport information with all available chart supplement (formerly Airport/Facility Directory) pages.
Chart supplements contain detailed airport information including runway data, lighting, services,
NOTAMs, and other operational details published by the FAA. The PDF URLs are time-limited pre-signed URLs.

airportCity.description: City the airport is associated with.

airportCode.description: Airport ICAO code or FAA identifier used to query this data.

supplements.description: List of chart supplement PDF pages with time-limited download URLs. Multi-page supplements will have one entry per page.

ChartSupplementDto.description: A single chart supplement page with a time-limited pre-signed URL for PDF download.

pdfUrl.description: Pre-signed URL to download the chart supplement PDF page. This URL expires after a limited time period; request a new URL if it has expired.

CommunicationFrequencyDto.description: Airport communication frequency data from the FAA NASR database.

effectiveDate.description: Date the frequency record became effective.

servicedFacility.description: FAA identifier of the serviced facility.

servicedSiteType.description: Site type of the serviced facility.

frequencyUse.description: Intended use of the frequency (e.g., ATIS, TWR, GND).

AirportCrosswindResponseDto.description: Response DTO containing crosswind components for all runways at an airport

airportIdentifier.description: ICAO code or identifier of the airport

windDirectionDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees from METAR (null if variable)

windSpeedKt.description: Wind speed in knots from METAR

windGustKt.description: Wind gust speed in knots from METAR (if reported)

isVariableWind.description: Whether the wind was reported as variable (VRB)

runways.description: Crosswind components for each runway end at the airport

recommendedRunway.description: Recommended runway end identifier (lowest crosswind with headwind)

RunwayCrosswindComponentDto.description: Crosswind component data for a single runway end

crosswindKt.description: Crosswind component in knots. Positive = from the right, Negative = from the left

headwindKt.description: Headwind component in knots. Positive = headwind, Negative = tailwind

gustCrosswindKt.description: Crosswind component from gusts in knots (if gust data available). Positive = from the right

gustHeadwindKt.description: Headwind component from gusts in knots (if gust data available). Positive = headwind

absoluteCrosswindKt.description: Absolute value of crosswind component (for comparison purposes)

hasHeadwind.description: Whether this runway has a headwind (favorable) vs tailwind

CrosswindCalculationResponseDto.description: Response DTO for a single crosswind calculation

crosswindKt.description: Crosswind component in knots. Positive = from the right, Negative = from the left

headwindKt.description: Headwind component in knots. Positive = headwind, Negative = tailwind

gustCrosswindKt.description: Crosswind component from gusts in knots (if gust data provided). Positive = from the right

gustHeadwindKt.description: Headwind component from gusts in knots (if gust data provided). Positive = headwind

windGustKt.description: Wind gust speed used in calculation (knots)

isVariableWind.description: Whether the wind was reported as variable (VRB)

CrosswindCalculationRequestDto.description: Request DTO for manual crosswind calculation with user-provided parameters

windDirectionDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees (0-360, or null for variable)

DensityAltitudeResponseDto.description: Response DTO for density altitude calculation

isaTemperatureCelsius.description: Standard (ISA) temperature at this pressure altitude in Celsius

temperatureDeviationCelsius.description: Temperature deviation from ISA in Celsius

rawMetar.description: Raw METAR text for reference (for airport-based calculations)

DensityAltitudeRequestDto.description: Request DTO for manual density altitude calculation

altimeterInHg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury (inHg)

WindTriangleResponseDto.description: Response DTO for wind triangle calculation containing heading and ground speed results.

trueHeadingDegrees.description: True heading in degrees (0–360), corrected for wind

windCorrectionAngleDegrees.description: Wind correction angle in degrees (positive = right correction, negative = left)

headwindComponentKt.description: Headwind component in knots (positive = headwind, negative = tailwind)

crosswindComponentKt.description: Crosswind component in knots (positive = from the right, negative = from the left)

WindTriangleRequestDto.description: Request DTO for wind triangle (heading and ground speed) calculation.

trueAirspeedKt.description: True airspeed in knots (must be greater than 0)

TrueAirspeedResponseDto.description: Response DTO for true airspeed calculation.

densityAltitudeFt.description: Density altitude in feet at the given conditions

machNumber.description: Mach number at the given conditions

outsideAirTemperatureCelsius.description: Outside air temperature used in calculation (°C)

TrueAirspeedRequestDto.description: Request DTO for true airspeed (TAS) calculation.

calibratedAirspeedKt.description: Calibrated (indicated) airspeed in knots (must be greater than 0)

pressureAltitudeFt.description: Pressure altitude in feet (can be negative, e.g. Death Valley)

outsideAirTemperatureCelsius.description: Outside air temperature in degrees Celsius

CloudBaseResponseDto.description: Response DTO for cloud base estimation.

estimatedCloudBaseFtAgl.description: Estimated cloud base in feet AGL

CloudBaseRequestDto.description: Request DTO for cloud base estimation.

dewpointCelsius.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Celsius (must be ≤ temperature)

PressureAltitudeResponseDto.description: Response DTO for standalone pressure altitude calculation.

altimeterCorrectionFt.description: Altimeter correction — deviation from standard pressure expressed in feet

fieldElevationFt.description: Field elevation used in calculation (feet MSL)

PressureAltitudeRequestDto.description: Request DTO for standalone pressure altitude calculation.

altimeterInHg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury (must be between 25.0 and 35.0 inHg)

GAirmetDto.description: G-AIRMET (Graphical AIRMET) advisory data with hazard, altitude, and area information.

validTime.description: Time the advisory is valid for.

product.description: Product type: SIERRA, TANGO, or ZULU.

geometryType.description: Geometry type of the affected area.

area.description: Geographic area affected by the advisory.

GAirmetAltitude.description: Represents altitude information for a G-AIRMET

minFtMsl.description: Minimum altitude in feet MSL. Can be a number, "SFC" for surface, or "FZL" for freezing level

levelFtMsl.description: Single level altitude in feet MSL (used for freezing level lines)

fzlAltitude.description: Freezing level altitude range (when min_ft_msl is "FZL")

minFtMsl.description: Minimum freezing level in feet MSL

maxFtMsl.description: Maximum freezing level in feet MSL

GAirmetArea.description: Geographic area affected by a G-AIRMET, defined as a polygon of lat/lon points.

numPoints.description: Number of points defining the polygon boundary.

points.description: Ordered list of lat/lon points forming the polygon boundary of the affected area.

GAirmetPoint.description: A geographic coordinate point forming part of a G-AIRMET area boundary polygon.

MetarDto.description: METAR (Meteorological Aerodrome Report) observation data for an airport.

rawText.description: Raw METAR text string as received from the source.

windDirDegrees.description: Wind direction in degrees true, or "VRB" for variable.

altimInHg.description: Altimeter setting in inches of mercury.

qualityControlFlags.description: Quality control flags for the observation.

wxString.description: Present weather string (e.g., "-RA" for light rain).

skyCondition.description: Sky condition layers (cloud cover and bases).

flightCategory.description: Flight category: VFR, MVFR, IFR, or LIFR.

MetarQualityControlFlagsDto.description: Quality control flags indicating METAR observation characteristics.

MetarSkyConditionDto.description: A single sky condition layer in a METAR observation.

skyCover.description: Sky cover type: SKC, CLR, FEW, SCT, BKN, or OVC.

cloudBaseFtAgl.description: Cloud base height in feet AGL.

PaginatedResponseOfMetarDto.description:

NavlogResponseDto.description:
Complete navigation log calculation result for a VFR cross-country flight.
Includes per-leg calculations (course, speed, fuel, wind) and references to airspace and obstacle
data along the route. Use the returned identifiers with the Airspace and Obstacle endpoints to
retrieve full details about en-route hazards.

totalRouteDistance.description: Total route distance in nautical miles (sum of all leg distances).

totalRouteTimeHours.description: Total estimated en-route time in hours (including climb and descent phases).

totalFuelUsed.description: Total fuel consumed for the entire route in gallons (including start/taxi/takeoff fuel).

averageWindComponent.description: Average wind component across all legs in knots. Negative values indicate a net headwind; positive values indicate a net tailwind.

legs.description: Ordered list of navigation legs between each pair of consecutive waypoints, containing computed course, speed, fuel, and wind data.

airspaceGlobalIds.description:
Global IDs of controlled airspaces (Class B, C, D, E) that the route passes through.
Use these IDs with the GET /api/v1/airspaces/by-global-ids?globalIds=... endpoint to retrieve full airspace details including boundaries and altitude limits.

specialUseAirspaceGlobalIds.description:
Global IDs of special use airspaces (restricted, prohibited, MOA, warning, alert) that the route passes through.
Use these IDs with the GET /api/v1/airspaces/special-use/by-global-ids?globalIds=... endpoint to retrieve full airspace details including boundaries and altitude limits.

obstacleOasNumbers.description:
OAS (Obstacle Assessment Surface) numbers of obstacles near the route.
Use these numbers with the POST /api/v1/obstacles/by-oas-numbers endpoint to retrieve full obstacle details including type, height, and lighting.

NavigationLegDto.description: A single navigation leg between two waypoints with computed flight data.

magneticHeading.description: Magnetic heading in degrees (corrected for wind and variation).

magneticCourse.description: Magnetic course in degrees (corrected for variation only).

distanceRemaining.description: Remaining distance to destination in nautical miles.

startLegTime.description: Estimated time at the start of this leg (UTC).

endLegTime.description: Estimated time at the end of this leg (UTC).

legFuelBurnGals.description: Fuel burned during this leg in gallons.

remainingFuelGals.description: Remaining fuel at the end of this leg in gallons.

windDir.description: Forecast wind direction in degrees true.

WaypointDto.description: A waypoint along a navigation route.

id.description: Waypoint identifier (e.g., ICAO code or custom name).

waypointType.description: Type of waypoint (e.g., airport, navaid, user-defined).

refuelGallons.description: Gallons to add during a refueling stop.

refuelToFull.description: Whether to refuel to full capacity at this stop.

isRefuelingStop.description: Whether this waypoint is a refueling stop.

NavlogRequestDto.description: Request to calculate a VFR navigation log for a cross-country flight.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of waypoints defining the route.

performanceData.description: Aircraft performance parameters for the flight.

plannedCruisingAltitude.description: Planned cruising altitude in feet MSL.

NavlogPerformanceDataDto.description: Aircraft performance data used for navigation log calculations.

climbTrueAirspeed.description: True airspeed during climb in knots.

cruiseTrueAirspeed.description: True airspeed during cruise in knots.

descentTrueAirspeed.description: True airspeed during descent in knots.

climbFpm.description: Rate of climb in feet per minute.

descentFpm.description: Rate of descent in feet per minute.

climbFuelBurn.description: Fuel burn rate during climb in gallons per hour.

cruiseFuelBurn.description: Fuel burn rate during cruise in gallons per hour.

descentFuelBurn.description: Fuel burn rate during descent in gallons per hour.

sttFuelGals.description: Fuel used during start, taxi, and takeoff in gallons.

fuelOnBoardGals.description: Total fuel on board at departure in gallons.

BearingAndDistanceResponseDto.description: Result of a bearing and distance calculation between two points.

magneticCourse.description: Magnetic course in degrees (adjusted for magnetic variation).

BearingAndDistanceRequestDto.description: Request to calculate bearing and distance between two geographic points.

startLatitude.description: Starting point latitude in decimal degrees.

startLongitude.description: Starting point longitude in decimal degrees.

endLatitude.description: Ending point latitude in decimal degrees.

endLongitude.description: Ending point longitude in decimal degrees.

WindsAloftDto.description: Winds aloft forecast data for a specific forecast period.

validTime.description: Valid time for the forecast data.

forUseStartTime.description: Start of the forecast use period.

forUseEndTime.description: End of the forecast use period.

windTemp.description: Wind and temperature data for each reporting site.

WindsAloftSiteDto.description: Winds aloft data for a single reporting site.

windTemp.description: Wind and temperature data keyed by altitude level (e.g., "3000", "6000").

WindTempDto.description: Wind direction, speed, and temperature at a specific altitude level.

direction.description: Wind direction in degrees true (null if calm or light/variable).

temperature.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius (not available at all altitudes).

NotamResponseDto.description:
Response containing NOTAMs (Notices to Air Missions) matching a query.
NOTAMs are returned as GeoJSON Features from the FAA NOTAM Search (NMS) system.

notams.description: List of NOTAMs matching the query, each represented as a GeoJSON Feature with geometry and properties.

totalCount.description: Total number of NOTAMs returned in this response.

retrievedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the NOTAMs were retrieved from the FAA NMS system.

queryLocation.description: Description of the queried location (e.g., airport identifier, coordinates, or route description).

NotamDto.description:
Represents a NOTAM as a GeoJSON Feature from the NMS API.
See nms-api.yaml NmsNotamData schema for full specification.

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry representing the NOTAM's geographic location or affected area (Point, Polygon, or GeometryCollection).

properties.description: NOTAM properties containing the core NOTAM data, detail fields, and translations.

NotamGeometryDto.description: GeoJSON geometry - can be Point, Polygon, or GeometryCollection

coordinates.description:
For Point: [lon, lat] array
For Polygon: array of coordinate rings
For GeometryCollection: null (use Geometries instead)

geometries.description: For GeometryCollection type - contains child geometries

NotamPropertiesDto.description: Properties of a NOTAM GeoJSON Feature containing the core NOTAM data.

notamEvent.description: NOTAM event metadata (encoding format and scenario).

notam.description: The NOTAM detail fields including identifier, text, effective dates, location, and classification.

notamTranslation.description: NOTAM text translations in various formats (plain English, domestic format, ICAO format).

Core NOTAM detail fields per NMS API specification.
Classification values: INTERNATIONAL, MILITARY, LOCAL_MILITARY, DOMESTIC, FDC
Feature values: RWY, TWY, APRON, AD, OBST, NAV, COM, SVC, AIRSPACE, ODP, SID, STAR, CHART, DATA, DVA, IAP, VFP, ROUTE, SPECIAL, SECURITY

classification.description: Classification: INTERNATIONAL, MILITARY, LOCAL_MILITARY, DOMESTIC, FDC

NOTAM translation in various formats.

List of airport identifiers (ICAO codes or FAA identifiers) along the route.
Use this for simple airport-only queries. For mixed airport/waypoint routes, use RoutePoints instead.

routePoints.description:
Ordered list of route points (airports and/or waypoints) in flight sequence.

cloudTopFtMsl.description: Cloud top altitude in feet MSL.

turbulenceTopFtMsl.description: Top of the turbulence layer in feet MSL.

icingTopFtMsl.description: Top of the icing layer in feet MSL.

fcstTimeTo.description: End of this forecast period in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

probability.description: Probability percentage (e.g., 30 or 40) for PROB-type forecast periods.

windGustKt.description: Forecast wind gust speed in knots.

windShearHgtFtAgl.description: Low-level wind shear height in feet AGL.

windShearDirDegrees.description: Low-level wind shear direction in degrees true.

windShearSpeedKt.description: Low-level wind shear speed in knots.

visibilityStatuteMi.description: Forecast visibility in statute miles. May contain "6+" for visibility greater than 6 miles.

vertVisFt.description: Vertical visibility in feet, reported when the sky is obscured.

turbulenceConditions.description: Forecast turbulence conditions for this period.

icingConditions.description: Forecast icing conditions for this period.

temperature.description: Forecast temperature data for this period.

TafSkyCondition.description: A single sky condition layer in a TAF forecast period.

skyCover.description: Sky cover type: SKC (sky clear), CLR (clear), FEW (few), SCT (scattered), BKN (broken), or OVC (overcast).

cloudBaseFtAgl.description: Cloud base height in feet AGL. Null for SKC or CLR.

cloudType.description: Cloud type modifier (e.g., CB for cumulonimbus, TCU for towering cumulus).

TafTurbulenceCondition.description: Forecast turbulence condition within a TAF forecast period.

turbulenceIntensity.description: Turbulence intensity code: 0 (none), 1 (light), 2 (moderate occasional), 3 (moderate frequent), 4 (severe), 5 (extreme), or X (mountain wave).

turbulenceMinAltFtAgl.description: Bottom of the turbulence layer in feet AGL.

turbulenceMaxAltFtAgl.description: Top of the turbulence layer in feet AGL.

TafIcingCondition.description: Forecast icing condition within a TAF forecast period.

icingIntensity.description: Icing intensity code: 0 (none), 1 (light), 2 (light in clouds), 3 (light in precipitation), 4 (moderate), 5 (moderate in clouds), 6 (moderate in precipitation), 7 (severe), 8 (severe in clouds), 9 (severe in precipitation).

icingMinAltFtAgl.description: Bottom of the icing layer in feet AGL.

icingMaxAltFtAgl.description: Top of the icing layer in feet AGL.

TafTemperature.description: Forecast temperature data within a TAF forecast period.

validTime.description: Valid time for this temperature forecast in ISO 8601 format (UTC).

sfcTempC.description: Forecast surface temperature in degrees Celsius.

maxTempC.description: Forecast maximum temperature in degrees Celsius.

minTempC.description: Forecast minimum temperature in degrees Celsius.

tags.name: Airports
tags.description: Provides access to FAA airport data from the National Airspace System Resources (NASR) database. Airports can be queried by ICAO code, FAA identifier, state, or text search. Use an airport's ICAO code or identifier to query related data from other endpoints such as METARs, TAFs, runways, communication frequencies, airport diagrams, and chart supplements.

tags.name: Airport Diagrams
tags.description: Provides access to FAA airport diagram PDFs. Airport diagrams show taxiways, runways, buildings, and other ground features. Diagrams are returned as time-limited pre-signed URLs for PDF download.

tags.name: Weather - AIRMETs/SIGMETs
tags.description: Provides access to AIRMET and SIGMET advisories. AIRMETs warn of weather hazards significant to light aircraft (moderate turbulence/icing, IFR conditions, mountain obscuration). SIGMETs warn of severe weather hazards significant to all aircraft (severe turbulence/icing, convective activity). Each advisory includes the hazard type, severity, altitude range, and geographic polygon defining the affected area.

tags.name: Airspace
tags.description: Provides access to controlled airspace (Class B, C, D) and special use airspace (restricted, prohibited, warning, MOA, alert) data sourced from FAA ArcGIS services. Each airspace includes boundary geometry (GeoJSON), altitude limits, and classification. Airspace GlobalIds are returned by the navigation log endpoint for airspaces along a planned route — use the by-global-ids endpoints to retrieve full details for those airspaces.

tags.name: Chart Supplements
tags.description: Provides access to FAA Chart Supplement (formerly Airport/Facility Directory) PDFs. Chart supplements contain comprehensive airport information including detailed runway data, lighting, available services, airspace, and other operational details. PDFs are returned as time-limited pre-signed URLs.

tags.name: Communication Frequencies
tags.description: Provides access to airport and facility communication frequency data from the FAA NASR database. Includes tower, ground, ATIS, approach/departure, clearance delivery, and other radio frequencies associated with airports and air traffic control facilities.

tags.name: E6B Flight Computer
tags.description: Provides E6B flight computer calculations for VFR pilots, including crosswind components, density altitude, wind triangle, true airspeed, cloud base estimation, and pressure altitude. Airport-based calculations automatically use the latest METAR data for wind, temperature, and altimeter settings. Manual calculation endpoints allow you to provide your own parameters. DISCLAIMER: These calculations are intended for PRE-FLIGHT planning purposes only and must not be used for in-flight navigation. Results are approximations based on the ICAO Standard Atmosphere (ISA) model, which assumes mid-latitude atmospheric conditions. The actual tropopause altitude varies from ~26,000 ft at the poles to ~55,000 ft at the equator, and real atmospheric conditions differ from the ISA model. Always verify against certified instruments and official flight planning tools.

tags.name: Weather - G-AIRMETs
tags.description: Provides access to G-AIRMETs (Graphical AIRMETs) — graphical weather advisories issued by the Aviation Weather Center. G-AIRMETs are organized by product type: SIERRA (IFR/mountain obscuration), TANGO (turbulence/wind shear/surface winds), and ZULU (icing/freezing level). They can also be queried by specific hazard type (e.g., ICE, TURB_LO, IFR). Each advisory includes the hazard, severity, altitude range, and geographic polygon of the affected area. G-AIRMETs are issued every 3 hours with forecasts at 0, 3, 6, 9, and 12 hour intervals.

tags.name: Weather - METARs
tags.description: Provides access to METAR (Meteorological Aerodrome Report) observations. METARs are routine weather observations from airport weather stations, updated approximately every hour. METAR data is also used by the Performance endpoints to automatically calculate crosswind and density altitude for airports.

tags.name: Navigation Log
tags.description: Provides VFR cross-country flight planning tools including full navigation log calculation, bearing/distance computation, and winds aloft data. The navigation log calculates course, heading, ground speed, time, and fuel for each leg while accounting for wind and magnetic variation. The navlog response also identifies airspaces and obstacles along the route — use the returned IDs with the Airspace and Obstacle endpoints to retrieve full details.

tags.name: NOTAMs
tags.description: Provides access to NOTAMs (Notices to Air Missions) from the FAA NOTAM Search (NMS) system. NOTAMs contain time-critical aeronautical information about airport closures, airspace restrictions, runway conditions, navigation aid outages, and other flight safety hazards. NOTAMs are returned as GeoJSON Features with geographic geometry and detailed properties including effective dates, text content, and plain-English translations. Query by airport, geographic radius, or along a flight route.

tags.name: Obstacles
tags.description: Provides access to obstacle data from the FAA Digital Obstacle File (DOF). Obstacles include towers, buildings, smokestacks, and other structures that may affect flight safety. Each obstacle has an OAS (Obstacle Assessment Surface) number as its unique identifier. OAS numbers are returned by the navigation log endpoint for obstacles near a planned route — use the by-oas-numbers endpoint to retrieve full details for those obstacles.

tags.name: Weather - PIREPs
tags.description: Provides access to PIREPs (Pilot Reports) — real-time weather observations reported by pilots in flight. PIREPs contain firsthand reports of turbulence, icing, sky conditions, visibility, and other flight conditions at specific altitudes and locations. Unlike METARs (ground-based), PIREPs describe conditions aloft. Report types are UA (routine) or UUA (urgent, indicating severe conditions).

tags.name: Weather - TAFs
tags.description: Provides access to TAF (Terminal Aerodrome Forecast) data. TAFs are weather forecasts for airports, typically covering a 24-30 hour period with forecast periods describing expected wind, visibility, sky conditions, and weather phenomena. TAFs are issued approximately every 6 hours for airports with weather reporting capabilities.
